steps: Put the chickpeas in a saucepan with the baking soda, cover well with water, bring to a boil and simmer about 20 minutes until very soft and starting to fall apart. Drain and rinse under cool water.
Meanwhile, blitz the lemon juice, garlic and salt in a food processor until the garlic is finely chopped. Let it sit 10 minutes to mellow the garlic.
Add the tahini and blend until thick and creamy, scraping the sides.
With the motor running, drizzle in 2 tbsp ice water and blend until pale and ultra-smooth. Add more water if needed.
Add the cumin and the cooked chickpeas. Blend about 2 minutes, drizzling in the olive oil, until completely smooth.
Taste and adjust salt and lemon. Spread in a bowl, swoosh with a spoon, drizzle with olive oil and garnish. Keeps up to 1 week in the fridge.
